meaning: The assistant's sentence carries two or more negations -- no longer, never, not, cannot, without -- stacked so the reader must untangle them before knowing what happens, where the positive action would say it directly.
match: The hook that catches admitted wrong checks no longer queues a check it can never deliver when a helper agent stops.
The retry does not run unless the queue is not empty.
The agent cannot report a failure it did not observe.
The gate never blocks a push that has not already passed.
not_match: The hook skips checks it could never deliver once the helper agent stops.
The transcript file does not exist.
The rule bans sentences like 'no longer queues a check it can never deliver'.
The retry runs when the queue has items.
on_hit: plain-words: the last reply stacked two or more negations in one sentence; rewrite it as the positive action.
